Reduce memory usage of the server's SpawnDistributions by 750MB (780MB -> 40MB) and make it 3x faster to sample (2.1 us -> 0.7 us)
- store in tiles of 16x16 values
- 85% of the tiles are all zeros (fun fact)
- tiles that are all the same value store as negative tile index so it can avoid looking up the tile (mainly all zeros)
- deduplicate the remaining tiles (saves a little more)
- palette packing on top for tiles that have mixed values (2 - 4 bits / value)
- reduces server startup time from 4s -> 2.5s
